name: jellyfin.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: Jellyfin (films and music)
shortDescription: Your own streaming service for your films, series and music
description: Your own streaming service for the films, series, music and home videos you keep on your AVADO: watch them on your TV, phone, tablet or computer, with no subscription and no tracking. Getting started: open Jellyfin, choose your language and make your user name and password. Then choose "Add films and music" in Jellyfin's menu and pick files or folders on your computer; they appear in Jellyfin a few minutes later. On a TV or phone, install the free Jellyfin app and use the server address https://jellyfin.my.ava.do (at home, or away through Remote Access). Your AVADO gives the Ethereum node priority, so converting a video for a phone may pause briefly while the node is busy.
author: AVADO
